base: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before.
business: A practical mismatch needs adjustment; change the arrangement instead of repeating the same workaround.
shadow: Pressure escalates when each side keeps demanding terms the other cannot sustain.
arcApplying: The mismatch becomes harder to work around as exactness approaches.
arcSeparating: The pressure eases after exactness, leaving the changed arrangement to prove itself.

readerCopy.body: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before. When Chiron squares the North Node, criticism, visibility, asking for help, trying again, or entering a similar situation can bring the earlier experience back into the decision with more authority than it deserves. The fear may still contain useful information about what needs protection now. Update the boundary, preparation, or support without assuming the only safe choice is never returning to anything that resembles the old problem.
